parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO users (max_user_id, username, first_name, last_name, status, max_channels_limits, first_start_at, policy_version, policy_accepted_at)
  VALUES ($1::bigint, NULLIF($2,''), NULLIF($3,''), NULLIF($4,''), 'ACTIVE', 10, NOW(), '1.0', NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (max_user_id) WHERE max_user_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, public_id
)
SELECT id, public_id FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT id, public_id FROM users
WHERE max_user_id = $1::bigint AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins);

WITH ins_channel AS (
  INSERT INTO channels
    (user_id, max_chat_id, title, filter_prompt, generation_prompt,
     posting_hours, timezone, is_active, tg_chat_id)
  SELECT $1::integer, $2::bigint, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, false, NULL
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM channels
    WHERE user_id = $1::integer AND max_chat_id = $2::bigint
  )
  RETURNING id
),
ins_sources AS (
  INSERT INTO sources (channel_id, user_id, source_url, last_processed_id)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins_channel), $1::integer, s.url, s.last_processed_id
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($8::jsonb) AS s(url text, last_processed_id int)
  WHERE (SELECT id FROM ins_channel) IS NOT NULL
),
upd_user AS (
  UPDATE users SET onboarding_completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = $1::integer
    AND (SELECT id FROM ins_channel) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins_channel) AS channel_id;

parameters.query:
WITH result AS (
  UPDATE bot_sessions
  SET context = jsonb_set(
        context - 'pending_source',
        '{sources}',
        COALESCE(context->'sources', '[]'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb
      ),
      updated_at = NOW(),
      expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
  WHERE id = $2
    AND jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(context->'sources', '[]'::jsonb)) < 10
    AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(context->'sources', '[]'::jsonb)) e
          WHERE e->>'url' = $3
        )
  RETURNING jsonb_array_length(context->'sources') AS count
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT count FROM result), -1)    AS count,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM result)               AS was_added;

UPDATE bot_sessions
SET context    = context - 'pending_source',
    updated_at = NOW(),
    expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
WHERE id = $1;
